note: Ceilings for tests/test_fleet_trial.py, per role and in total: tool_calls counts every MCP tool call the scripted agent makes in one run of the conductor recipe, bytes_received the UTF-8 bytes of the text content of every answer, single_acks the calls that acknowledge one notification. All are the measured values, identical over five runs, with no headroom. A requirement that removes calls lowers them in the same commit; raise one only with a stated reason in the same PR. The reviewer's scratch run against a live demo (2026-11-22) counted the same 142 calls and 39 acknowledgements and 382,369 bytes: its longer ids and names, and put-down drains that re-read each seat's feed from its first cursor, account for the difference.
